ex.en: The tourism industry is highly cyclical.
ex.zh: 觀光業具有高度的週期性。

ex.en: Cyclical unemployment rises during a recession.
ex.zh: 景氣衰退時，循環性失業會增加。

ex.en: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
ex.zh: 我通常騎腳踏車或搭公車上班。

ex.en: Most of the pupils here cycle to school.
ex.zh: 這裡大多數學生騎車上學。

ex.en: That young man is very keen on cycling.
ex.zh: 那個年輕人非常熱衷騎腳踏車。

ex.en: The product life cycle is getting shorter.
ex.zh: 產品生命週期越來越短。

ex.en: We review the budget in a three-month cycle.
ex.zh: 我們以三個月為週期檢討預算。

ex.en: The fashion industry is highly cyclic.
ex.zh: 時尚產業具有高度循環性。

ex.en: Sales show a cyclic pattern every year.
ex.zh: 銷售每年都呈現週期性變化。

ex.en: The tower is shaped like a cylinder.
ex.zh: 這座塔的形狀像一個圓柱。

ex.en: Calculate the volume of the cylinder.
The piston does not come into contact with the cylinder cover.

cyclone.zh: 氣旋、熱帶氣旋（颶風、颱風）

ex.en: All flights were canceled because of the cyclone.
ex.zh: 所有航班都因為氣旋而取消。

ex.en: The cyclone caused serious damage to the coast.
ex.zh: 這個氣旋對沿海地區造成嚴重損害。
